short.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth of Astra's standard token price
short.description:
The lower standard price gives developers another cost-performance option for capable agentic workloads. OpenAI's Preparedness Framework classifies GPT-6.1 Sol as Critical for cybersecurity capability, which is a capability threshold; OpenAI says it applies the same safeguards stack used for GPT-6 Astra.

Read today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief: https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Sol through its API, ChatGPT Work and Codex at one-fifth of Astra's standard token price. Sol Ultrafast is still coming rather than available at launch. Read the Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
